```{r}
#| ECHO: FALSE
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(rsample)
```

Reading in the data
```{r}
seoul_bike <- read_csv("Homework 9/LoganHW9/SeoulBikeData.csv",
                  locale = locale(encoding = "latin1"))
seoul_bike
```

Checking the data
```{r}
seoul_bike %>% summarize(across(everything(), ~ sum(is.na(.x))))

str(seoul_bike)

seoul_bike %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% summary()

unique(seoul_bike$`Functioning Day`)
unique(seoul_bike$Holiday)
unique(seoul_bike$Seasons)
```

Everything in the data looks good, so we move on to cleaning the data

```{r}
seoul_bike <- seoul_bike %>%
  mutate(Date = dmy(Date),
         Seasons = factor(Seasons, levels = c("Winter", "Spring",
                                              "Summer", "Autumn")),
         Holiday = factor(Holiday),
         `Functioning Day` = factor(`Functioning Day`)) %>%
  rename(date = Date,
         bike = `Rented Bike Count`,
         hour = Hour,
         temperature = `Temperature(°C)`,
         humidity = `Humidity(%)`,
         wind_speed = `Wind speed (m/s)`,
         visibility = `Visibility (10m)`,
         dew_point = `Dew point temperature(°C)`,
         solar_radiation = `Solar Radiation (MJ/m2)`,
         rainfall = `Rainfall(mm)`,
         snowfall = `Snowfall (cm)`,
         seasons = Seasons,
         holiday = Holiday,
         functioning_day = `Functioning Day`)

seoul_bike
```

```{r}
seoul_bike %>% group_by(seasons) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_bike_count = mean(bike),
            median_bike_count = median(bike),
            sd_bike_count = sd(bike),
            min_bike_count = min(bike),
            max_bike_count = max(bike))
```

```{r}
seoul_bike %>% group_by(holiday) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_bike_count = mean(bike),
            median_bike_count = median(bike),
            sd_bike_count = sd(bike),
            min_bike_count = min(bike),
            max_bike_count = max(bike))
```

```{r}
seoul_bike %>% group_by(functioning_day) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_bike_count = mean(bike),
            median_bike_count = median(bike),
            sd_bike_count = sd(bike),
            min_bike_count = min(bike),

```

Filtering for only when the system is functioning
```{r}
seoul_bike <- seoul_bike %>% filter(functioning_day == "Yes") 
seoul_bike
```

```{r}
seoul_daily <- seoul_bike %>%
  group_by(date, seasons, holiday) %>%
  summarize(bike = sum(bike),
            rainfall = sum(rainfall),
            snowfall = sum(snowfall),
            temperature = mean(temperature),
            humidity = mean(humidity),
            wind_speed = mean(wind_speed),
            visibility = mean(visibility),
            dew_point = mean(dew_point),
            solar_radiation = mean(solar_radiation)) %>%
  ungroup()
seoul_daily
```

```{r}
seoul_daily %>% 
  select(where(is.numeric)) %>%
  summary()
```

```{r}
seoul_daily %>% group_by(seasons) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_bike_count = mean(bike),
            median_bike_count = median(bike),
            sd_bike_count = sd(bike),
            min_bike_count = min(bike),
            max_bike_count = max(bike))
```

```{r}
seoul_daily %>% group_by(holiday) %>% 
  summarize(n = n(),
            mean_bike_count = mean(bike),

            sd_bike_count = sd(bike),
            min_bike_count = min(bike),

```


Creating plots to investigate relationships
```{r}
ggplot(data = seoul_daily, aes(x = seasons, y = bike)) +
  geom_boxplot() +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
ggplot(data = seoul_daily, 
       aes(x = temperature, y = bike, color = seasons)) +
  geom_point() + 
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
seoul_daily %>% select(where(is.numeric)) %>% cor() %>% round(2)
```

```{r}
set.seed(67)
seoul_split <- initial_split(seoul_daily, prop = .75, 
                             strata = seasons)
seoul_train <- training(seoul_split)
seoul_test <- testing(seoul_split)
seoul_train
seoul_test
```

```{r}
std_by <- function(x, ref){
  return((x-mean(ref)) / sd(ref))
}

seoul_train <- seoul_train %>% 
  mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 
                                   "Weekend", "Weekday")),
         temp_std = std_by(temperature, seoul_train$temperature),
         humidity_std = std_by(humidity, seoul_train$humidity),
         wind_speed_std = std_by(wind_speed, seoul_train$wind_speed),
         visibility_std = std_by(visibility, seoul_train$visibility),
         dew_point_temp_std = std_by(dew_point, 
                                     seoul_train$dew_point),
         solar_radiation_std = std_by(solar_radiation, 
                                      seoul_train$solar_radiation),
         rainfall_std = std_by(rainfall, seoul_train$rainfall),
         snowfall_std = std_by(snowfall, seoul_train$snowfall))

seoul_test <- seoul_test %>% 
  mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 
                                   "Weekend", "Weekday")),
         temp_std = std_by(temperature, seoul_test$temperature),
         humidity_std = std_by(humidity, seoul_test$humidity),
         wind_speed_std = std_by(wind_speed, seoul_test$wind_speed),
         visibility_std = std_by(visibility, seoul_test$visibility),
         dew_point_temp_std = std_by(dew_point, 
                                     seoul_test$dew_point),
         solar_radiation_std = std_by(solar_radiation, 
                                      seoul_test$solar_radiation),
         rainfall_std = std_by(rainfall, seoul_test$rainfall),
         snowfall_std = std_by(snowfall, seoul_test$snowfall))
```

```{r}
fit1 <- lm(bike ~ temp_std + humidity_std + wind_speed_std + visibility_std +
             dew_point_temp_std + solar_radiation_std + rainfall_std + snowfall_std +
             seasons + holiday + day_type,
           data = seoul_train)

fit2 <- lm(bike ~ temp_std + humidity_std + wind_speed_std + visibility_std +
             dew_point_temp_std + solar_radiation_std + rainfall_std + snowfall_std +
             seasons + holiday + day_type +
             seasons:holiday + seasons:temp_std + temp_std:rainfall_std,
           data = seoul_train)

fit3 <- lm(bike ~ temp_std + humidity_std + wind_speed_std + visibility_std +
             dew_point_temp_std + solar_radiation_std + rainfall_std + snowfall_std +
             seasons + holiday + day_type +
             seasons:holiday + seasons:temp_std + temp_std:rainfall_std +
             I(temp_std^2) + I(humidity_std^2),
           data = seoul_train)
```

```{r}
yardstick::rmse_vec(seoul_test$bike, predict(fit1, newdata = seoul_test))
yardstick::rmse_vec(seoul_test$bike, predict(fit2, newdata = seoul_test))
yardstick::rmse_vec(seoul_test$bike, predict(fit3, newdata = seoul_test))
```

```{r}
seoul_full <- seoul_daily %>%
  mutate(day_type = factor(if_else(wday(date) %in% c(1, 7), 
                                   "Weekend", "Weekday")),
         temp_std = std_by(temperature, seoul_daily$temperature),
         humidity_std = std_by(humidity, seoul_daily$humidity),
         wind_speed_std = std_by(wind_speed, seoul_daily$wind_speed),
         visibility_std = std_by(visibility, seoul_daily$visibility),
         dew_point_temp_std = std_by(dew_point, 
                                     seoul_daily$dew_point),
         solar_radiation_std = std_by(solar_radiation, 
                                      seoul_daily$solar_radiation),
         rainfall_std = std_by(rainfall, seoul_daily$rainfall),
         snowfall_std = std_by(snowfall, seoul_daily$snowfall))

final_fit <- lm(bike ~ temp_std + humidity_std + wind_speed_std + visibility_std +
             dew_point_temp_std + solar_radiation_std + rainfall_std + snowfall_std +
             seasons + holiday + day_type +
             seasons:holiday + seasons:temp_std + temp_std:rainfall_std,
           data = seoul_full)

coef(final_fit)
```
